verdict.rationale: Granola has its own REST API with scoped and workspace API keys, plus an official MCP server, but the documented access covers reading meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries. Nothing shows UI actions such as templates, recipes, Chat workflows, folder management, sharing, deletion, or retention settings are exposed programmatically, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: evidence of write/mutation endpoints, API coverage of templates/recipes/chat/folders/sharing/settings, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.
This RESTful API enables you to integrate Granola with your existing tools
When you create an API key, you choose which note access scopes it should include.
Query your notes, search transcripts, and get meeting insights in your favorite AI assistants.
